requirements.quote: Add DRT/DRAT status and cause-list parsers and NCLT benches nationally (extending nclt-blr, #38) with golden fixtures, registered in the adapter registry and forum catalogue config.
SARFAESI DM/CMM matters are tracked through eCourts sources already present.
Acceptance: parsers pass golden fixtures offline.

deliverables.change: new parseDrtStatus: PageSpec label map over readStatusPage (DRT and DRAT status page)
new parseNcltStatus: PageSpec label map over readStatusPage
export and dispatch the two new parsers in PARSERS
cover the new templates; stays offline
list the new drt and nclt status fixture inputs (synthetic, FICTIONAL)

new DRT/DRAT adapter: DRT_ADAPTER_ID 'in.drt', forum code list, access modes (user_supplied/none, counsel note), config, createDrtAdapter with an HTML cause-list parseCauseList modelled on ecourts/cause-list.ts, bundled config
new DRT cause-list HTML parser (anchored rows, unparsed rows, halls), pure
new tests: registry resolves every DRT/DRAT forum code, config matches bundled, parser unit cases
new golden fixtures dir for in.drt: manifest plus *.input.html and *.expected.json (synthetic, FICTIONAL)
new list of national NCLT bench forum codes
forumCodes = Bengaluru plus the national benches; id, version and config unchanged
add DRT bundled config to BUNDLED_ADAPTER_CONFIGS
add 'in.drt' to WORKBENCH_ADAPTERS so the fixture regression gate covers it
export ./drt/index.ts and update the header comment
seed national NCLT benches and DRT/DRAT forums (adapterId set, level A1); existing in.drt.bengaluru-1/-2 get adapterId in.drt, A1
update expected code list and A1 count, assert each new forum's adapterId resolves to a registered adapter id

preserve.what: NCLT adapter id, version, config and checksum stay in.nclt.bengaluru 1.0.0 so migration 0052 and packages/adapters/src/nclt-blr/config.test.ts still pass
parseCaseStatus behaviour for ecourts-district, madras-hc and karnataka-hc (packages/adapters/src/status/index.ts) and its consumer packages/core/src/case-watch/lookup.ts
adapters register no network access: packages/adapters/src/__tests__/no-network-lint.test.ts; parsers stay pure
Existing fixtures accuracy baseline entries (packages/adapters/fixtures/accuracy-baseline.json) must not drop

validate.command: pnpm --filter @causedeck/adapters exec vitest run --config vitest.golden.config.ts src/status src/nclt-blr src/__tests__/fixture-regression.test.ts src/__tests__/workbench.test.ts src/__tests__/golden.test.ts --maxWorkers=${FORGE_HOST_PARALLELISM:-2}
pnpm --filter @causedeck/adapters exec vitest run src/drt src/__tests__/registry.test.ts src/__tests__/no-network-lint.test.ts --maxWorkers=${FORGE_HOST_PARALLELISM:-2}

decisions.choice: Reuse adapter id in.nclt.bengaluru for all national NCLT benches instead of a new id
decisions.justification: id is pinned by migration 0052 (packages/db/migrations/0052_nclt_adapter_v1.sql), the loader (config/loader.ts:67) and the accuracy baseline; registry allows one adapter per forum code (registry.ts:44-48) and one adapter can list many forumCodes

decisions.choice: One in.drt adapter for DRT and DRAT forums, HTML cause-list parser copied from the eCourts one; no adapter_version/access_mode migration
decisions.justification: drt.gov.in pages are HTML tables (tribunals.ts:14-18 notes unverified); loader falls back to bundled configs (config/loader.ts:63-68); modes stay user_supplied/none until counsel review (#118, nclt-blr/index.ts:35-46)
real DRT/NCLT layouts are unverified and project fixtures are classified FICTIONAL (fixtures/README.md, fixtures/status/manifest.json:2)
